quality_action: Set out-of-range values to unknown; retain pairs. Recompute BMI from range-checked weight and height. Dose already normalized by an invalid source weight becomes unknown if that conversion required weight. Do not invalidate directly recorded per-kg rates solely for missing admission anthropometry.
main_unit: cuff-anchored phase0 primary pairs; pair-weighted proportions; patient-cluster resampling
same_minute: Recalculate arterial median using only source readings in the same recorded clock minute as cuff, within same treatment episode; not the full 5-minute median.
coverage: Within each continuous treatment episode containing both valid modalities, shared observed span is max(first cuff,first arterial) to min(last cuff,last arterial); denominator is cuff readings inside this span, numerator those paired within 5 minutes. This is an observed-span proxy, not proven catheter presence.
bootstrap: Resample all paired patients in a database with replacement; carry all their observations; percentile 95% CI. Use the same weights for subgroup differences. Empty bootstrap denominators excluded and counted.
precision_flag: 95% CI total width >0.30 is insufficient precision; never merge or omit strata for width.
meta: Known-dose pairs only, per endpoint and dose stratum; logit of observed rate, 0.5 correction to event and non-event counts only for boundary meta transforms; within-database variance from patient bootstrap logit SD; REML random effects, modified Hartung-Knapp (test=adhoc), I2 reported. Fewer than 2 usable databases: no pooled estimate.
model_sample: Low arterial MAP, known clean dose, complete observed age/sex/BMI/AF covariates. No missing-as-negative substitution. AF comparator is observed non-AF rhythm or diagnosis coverage without AF code; diagnosis absence without coverage is unknown.
model_knots: Three restricted-cubic-spline knots at the 10th,50th,90th percentiles of eligible pair-level dose; tied knots use linear fallback.
model: Binomial logit mixed model, patient random intercept, dose spline + arterial MAP + age + sex + BMI>40 + AF + database. Center/scale continuous covariates. glmer Laplace nAGQ=1, bobyqa maxfun=200000. Nonconvergence fallback: linear dose, then GLM with patient-cluster robust SE.
model_estimand: Pair-weighted marginal standardization over complete-case covariates, integrating a normal patient random intercept with 30-node Gauss-Hermite quadrature. 95% CI by delta method on standardized logit using fixed-effect covariance, random-effect variance treated as plug-in; label this approximation. Association estimation, not prediction-tool development.
bland_altman: Intercept plus patient random intercept, REML variance components; population LoA=bias +/-1.96*sqrt(patient variance+residual variance); separate arterial-MAP and dose stratifications plus cross-stratification supplement; LoA are not confidence intervals.
af_subgroups: MIMIC and Amsterdam rhythm-only; eICU documented AF diagnosis versus diagnosis-covered without AF diagnosis; SICdb excluded. Amsterdam AF is an explicit supplementary exception to no-subgroup default.
eicu_recovery_time_limit: 1 working day, nonblocking; only unambiguous dose units and concentration provenance; no cross-patient carry or guesses
source_audit: New random 50 low-arterial-MAP pairs per database, seed20261027; independent source SQL; local row-level evidence only
figure_backend: Python/Matplotlib, continuing the phase0 Python workflow; R only for statistical computations
everdac_annotation: Retain requested 2.5 reference on a separate protocol-dose ruler. Original trial threshold is norepinephrine tartrate plus epinephrine, not generic NE-eq; do not put an unlabeled equivalent cutoff on the NE-eq axis.

claims.positive: 升压药剂量越高，袖带越容易漏判低血压；在 NE-eq >X 时漏判率达到 Y%，提示 EVERDAC 的袖带优先策略在高剂量患者中需要补置动脉导管。
claims.negative: 各剂量层的漏判率相近，袖带优先策略可外推到 EVERDAC 覆盖不足的高剂量患者。
